evals.prompt: Make a map of the number of COVID cases per department in France from this GeoPackage.
expected_behavior: Inspects the layer first: fields, CRS, feature count, nulls
Normalizes counts by population before a choropleth, or uses proportional symbols for raw counts
States the classification method and units in the legend
Exports and opens the PNG or PDF to check it
must_not: Draws a choropleth of raw case counts
Reports success without looking at the exported file

evals.prompt: Fais-moi une carte d'inondation de la commune avec les hauteurs d'eau, pour un rapport au conseil municipal.
expected_behavior: Asks for or states the scenario (return period or event date) and the source
Uses fixed depth thresholds with a sequential blue ramp, zero depth transparent
Puts hillshade under the hazard layer and adds legend with units, source, date, scale bar
must_not: Uses natural breaks or a rainbow ramp for water depth
Leaves the scenario and source off the map

evals.prompt: Style my land cover raster (ESA WorldCover) in QGIS with PyQGIS and add a legend.
expected_behavior: Checks which class codes are present
Uses QgsPalettedRasterRenderer with the official WorldCover colors and class names
Adds the ESA WorldCover and Copernicus credit
must_not: Uses a continuous pseudocolor ramp on class codes

evals.prompt: Put my 400 MB parcels layer on a web map with Leaflet.
expected_behavior: Warns that large GeoJSON is too heavy and proposes vector tiles, for example PMTiles with MapLibre
Reprojects to EPSG:4326 for GeoJSON input
Keeps the attribution control with credits for every source
must_not: Inlines the whole layer as GeoJSON in the page

evals.prompt: Export the print layout to PDF at A3 for printing, my map is in EPSG:3857 and covers Scandinavia.
expected_behavior: Warns that a scale bar in Web Mercator is wrong at these latitudes and proposes a projected CRS for the area
Sets the page size before placing items and exports at 300 dpi
Opens the exported PDF to check text size and credits
